title: Between land and sea, life begins
bsTitle: Between land and sea, life begins
caption: International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem
copyright: Red mangrove in the Pig Keys, Honduras (© Mac Stone/Tandem Stills + Motion)
description: At sunrise in Honduras' Pig Keys—small, low-lying coastal islets tucked within mangrove-rich wetlands—a red mangrove lifts its tangled roots above glassy water. This striking scene captures what 26 July celebrates: the International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem, created to spotlight these vital coastal forests.
